### Needs live calibration

- SLOW_THRESHOLD — measure pit stop durations across multiple stops with tire changes; catalog normal vs slow timings from PitStopProgress state machine frames
- FUEL_JAM_TIMEOUT — observe PitStopOperationTimer during a refuel operation; measure tick count from fuel-level-flat to operation timeout
- REFUEL_RATE_THRESHOLD — monitor FuelLevel (veh+0x3984) per tick during refuel; compute rate and distinguish normal from slow
- meatball penalty enum values — attach Frida hook to StewardObject (0x8ACEE0) readers, enumerate penalty types issued during a race with mechanical failures
- pit lane zone entry/exit detection — trace wp_pitlane waypoint from .aiw and determine how the game sets pittingStatus or other in-pit-lane flag
- engine stall detection — find engine RPM offset (veh+? ) and measure what value constitutes 'stalled' (0 RPM vs some low threshold)
- safety car state detection — search for safety car deployed flag (related to yellow flag system); mods/safety_car/README.md may have the state offset
- tire compound enum values — reverse engineer nextChosenTires (veh+0x458C) values to determine which number = inter, slick, wet
- OnLineWetness intermediate vs wet thresholds — record values during live weather transitions: dry=0.0, damp=?, wet=?
- scheduled pit lap offset — find where the player's planned pit stop lap is stored; possibly adjacent to callToBox or in the pit strategy area
- T-car concept — determine if T-car (spare car) is a game mechanic or commentary-only flavor; check if any state tracks spare car status
- AI stall on grid detection — monitor formation lap engine RPM for all AI cars; determine what signals a start-line stall
